title: Vintage Playboy Magazine December 1965 Dinah Willis - See Pics
descriptionText: The product is a vintage December 1965 issue of Playboy Magazine featuring model Dinah Willis. This edition includes illustrated articles and photographs related to women, art & photography, and modeling. The magazine is in English and was published monthly in the United States. With a mix of content aimed at both men and women, this vintage Playboy Magazine offers a snapshot of cultural and artistic trends from over five decades ago.
